index-100: Read the lines in $: Services earns tens of thousands a month, Parts only a few hundred
Read the lines: every category starts at 100 in Jun 25 and shares one scale
Read the line under the chart: Parts ends at 84 in Sep 26
ranking: Read the Overall and In country columns: Customer 184 is #1 in both
Click Country leaders only to keep just the #1 customer of each country
Pick a category in Revenue from, such as Software: both ranks change with it
bins: Read Orders by value band: 295 orders under $100, 421 at $100-499, 294 at $500-999 and 490 at $1,000+
Click Revenue next to Bars show: the $1,000+ band brings in most of the money
Click $500 in Bin width: the histogram rebuilds with $500 bins
Click $250 to go back to $250 bins
targets: Read the chart with All countries: the dashed line is the $84k monthly target of all six countries
Read the chart: the line moves to Japan's $8k, and only August beats it (160%)
what-if: Read the totals: Scenario $1,327,669 against Actual $1,283,053, a +3.5% change
Drag the Hardware slider up and watch its bar and the totals move
Click Price war and compare each category's scenario bar with actual
cohort-from-rank: Click 10% next to Top customers by revenue
Read Revenue by customer decile: decile 1 holds the top 20 customers
Read Cohort vs everyone else: the chip Cohort: Top 10% (20) sits above a side-by-side of the cohort and the rest
bookmarks: Read Bookmarks: the first view, All countries · all dates · monthly, is already saved
Click ★ Save view: a new bookmark Japan · Q2 2026 · weekly appears
Click By revenue or pick another Time zone to change the view
Click a bookmark to bring back its filters, sort, grain and time zone and run the page again
url-state: Set the filters to Japan, Q2 and week
Press Share: the link gains a ?s= part that holds the snapshot
Send the link to a colleague: it opens on Japan, Q2 and weekly
reset: Pick Japan in the country menu and Completed in the status menu
Click Software in Revenue by category to select it
Click the × on one chip to reset just that filter
Click Reset all: every filter, the selection and the sort go back to their defaults
undo-redo: Pick Japan in the country menu, click Week, then click Software in Revenue by category
Read History: 1 · Country = Japan, 2 · Grain = week, 3 · Selected: Software
Click ↶ Undo or press Ctrl+Z: the page goes back to step 2, weekly Japan with no selection
Click ↷ Redo or press Ctrl+Shift+Z to bring the Software selection back
saved-views: Save the current view under a name, such as Monday: APAC weekly
Open the app next week on another device
Click Views: the saved view is still in your list, next to Finance: FY27 Q1
Click the view to bring it back
refresh: Read the line at the top: Data as of the newest order date, when the query ran, and fresh
Click Run again: under Runs, nothing re-runs because the input did not change
Click ⟳ Refresh: every query re-runs past the cache, and the run time updates
trend-line: Read the chart: the dashed Linear trend across all 16 months slopes down, −$56 a month
The last month is hatched: September 2026 has only 23 of 30 days. Leave out Sep 26 is on, so the fit uses 15 full months and reads +$342 a month
Click Leave out Sep 26 to turn it off: the line tips down again
Click Moving average, then 6 months: the line now comes from window_avg in the query
Click Linear, then Break down by category: each category gets its own trend, Software +$450 a month and Services −$202 a month
